Chinese package-locale metadata (title + description); the Chat copy itself lives in src/client/locale.ts, not here.

Per-heading EN/ZH hash record for README.md bilingual pairing, regenerated by pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write.

206-line package reference: reference previews, hidden rows, failure/quota rows, usage row, Turn folding, grouped rendering, scroll ownership; states "Model Experience: None" and "KV Cache effect: None" (the client never assembles or mutates provider requests).
Chinese mirror of README.md; same section anchors, same rules, translated prose.
Durable ui-chat settings schema (transcriptView/collapseTiming/performanceUsage/linkOpening) with legacy "normal"/"expanded" modes accepted-but-never-written and .loose() on transcriptView.

The plugin apply(): registers all conversation Definitions, the Chat view/flow/node slots, keyed renderers, three settings rows, the frame-wide quota-notice host, and the two composer stat pills; wires file/link/fork/image/scroll-memory injections.

8-line .visuallyHidden clip-path utility used for screen-reader-only announcements (running status, row states); the same 8 lines are duplicated inline in MessageIconActions.module.css rather than imported.
Approval detail renderer: resolves the correlated Tool call's command string from its raw arguments for the approval panel.

Assistant flow typography: body font-size rides --dsh-content-font-size with a shared px leading delta; IconActions sit 16px below the body; wide markdown tables break out to the transcript width via a 100cqw container query.

Renders assistant blocks: text Markdown, per-block reasoning rows, image galleries keyed by the group's FIRST block index so a streaming append grows rather than remounts, tool-call heads skipped entirely.

Keyed assistant-step renderer: computes turn-tail ownership from the tail's closing seq, resolves file mentions for the closing turn, and hides answer-attached reasoning when the Turn process is folded.

Flow renderer: maps the mixed node/group root sequence to seats, appends pending echo rows, and splices one local transcript echo BEFORE an empty opening Turn control so the echo keeps its mounted identity.
Group seat skin: header chevron/title layout, a body capped at min(400px, 50vh) with 24px directional fades, and member spacing that shares the closing body's 160ms timing.
Process-group seat: stable live title (150ms minimum), local disclosure, capped scroll body with its own follow controller, and outer-Turn hiding coordinated through the viewport hook.
Per-node seat: subscribes one stable key, decides Turn-process membership/answer from the process spec, bumps the disclosure reset when an enclosing Turn hides it, and dispatches the keyed renderer.

Transcript frame/column/scrollport, running indicator, and turn-spacer styles; the root uses overflow-y clip (NOT auto) so sticky banners keep the real scroller as their reference, and container-type inline-size so wide tables can query the transcript width.
The Chat view: node/group entry selection, pending-echo reconciliation by rpcId, scroll composition, file-open error dialog with retry, and the turn rail.
Command renderer dispatching to the keyed commandview slot by command name, with the generic card as the fallback.
Manual-compaction card: a structured checkpoint renders as the compaction marker, every other outcome keeps the command's own settlement text.
Compaction marker showing shadowed item/token counts; expandable only when the cited summary event is inside the loaded window.

One code-block-like surface shared by every context form so the disclosure keeps one geometry whichever form renders inside; the source-field key column is fixed at 96px so the value edge stays stable.
Per-form context bodies (instructions/catalog/snapshot/notice/relay/recall); every form parses its source ALL-OR-NOTHING and falls back to the opaque body rather than showing a partial list.
Context disclosure chrome: 24px Tool-calls header, 4px gap, 141px code-block body cap; reused by SystemPromptRow.
Context injection disclosure: names the producer role, summarizes tool additions/removals inline, and renders the body the producer's declared form actually resolved to.
Fold coordinator: every batch containing a closing row moves its boxes AND the scrollport on one frame clock; opt-in via [data-chat-motion], reduced-motion aware, temporary styles always cleared.
Command card skin (root/leading/title/separator/summary).
Command disclosure whose body mounts only while open and only when the settlement text is multiline.
Clock and elapsed-duration formatting helpers (same-day HH:mm vs dated), local-midnight helpers, and the 1s live-clock interval.
Shared user/assistant icon-actions row skin; visibility gated by recency through data-actions-reveal.

Copy/branch/clock action row: clipboard write with fallback, epoch-guarded success chrome so a stale write cannot claim success, and an aria-disabled (not disabled) branch button so the tooltip still fires.

User bubble (right-aligned, width capped as a share of the column axis), attachment card, compaction row (the toggle pins sticky while open and outranks the code-block banner by specificity, not load order), and turn-error/max-tokens rows.

Keyed renderers for user/steering/context/compaction/retry/turn-error/max-tokens/unknown plus the pending echo bubbles; the model-retry countdown anchors the host delay to this browser's first render.
Frame-wide shell.overlay host: holds the one live quota notice for the whole app and offers it to the shell.quota-notice chain with a warning Toast fallback.
The official root-scoped reasoning Content Factory and the default reasoning Body adapter, which calls the same Factory so a replacement sees one seam.
Reasoning disclosure skin; the collapsed row is size-contained so the preview cannot change the layout, and the streaming summary fades out with a right-edge mask instead of a hard clip.
Reasoning disclosure: settled preview is the first line, streaming preview is the latest COMPLETED paragraph's first line, and expanded body is the replaceable reasoning-body Slot.
Registers every keyed Chat node renderer plus the reasoning content Factory and the default reasoning body entry at priority 100.
Collision-free React keys for the two render-entry kinds: JSON-encoded [kind, key, groupPart] so a node's two parts never share a key.

Binary 28x28 APNG asset (PNG signature; IHDR/pHYs/acTL + 43 fcTL/fdAT frame pairs) used as the CSS mask for the running whale; it was inspected by chunk header rather than read line by line because it is a binary image.
Running indicator with a 1s clock isolated from the transcript's render cycle; before the Turn start time arrives it shows status text without a duration.
Decorative running glyph: a CSS-mask seat plus an inline static SVG fallback for reduced motion and forced colors.
hidden="until-found" visibility that keeps content findable by the browser, protects keyboard focus, and reveals on beforematch.
Shared stat-dialog skin (fixed portal surface, elevation, details list) used by both the Turn pill and the composer pills.
Anchored, viewport-clamped dialog seat; closes on Escape, outside pointerdown, and outside click in the capture phase so keyboard activation of a sibling swaps dialogs instead of stacking them.
Composer stat pill skin; the anchor shrink-wraps so the portal clamp measures the pill.

Two composer dock pills (activity/usage) that open portaled dialogs; every figure prefers the durable sessionStats/tokenUsage projections and falls back to a window-scoped fold with identical field names.
Composes a closed group's localized title from its top three ranked categories, with a shared-prefix rule for Chinese.
System-prompt disclosure whose expanded body is the same opaque context chrome as an injected context row.
Token count/percentage formatting, including formatCacheHitPercent, which binary-searches threshold units so a PARTIAL cache hit never rounds up to 100%.
Concatenates the visible text blocks of one assistant lifecycle.
Merges the host turnOutline projection with the loaded rail items; damaged navigation fields drop an entry while a malformed preview degrades to empty and the turn stays navigable.
Maps a recorded non-human trigger source (goal/agent/team/subagent/webhook/schedule/tool-jobs/cordis-host-runner) to a localized title and icon family.

Turn rail skin; the rail is a sibling of the clipped transcript at z-index 7 so it paints above code-block banners, its marks are fixed-pitch (the rail never measures the transcript), and the whole rail is hidden below a 900px container.
Fixed-pitch virtualized turn rail (10px marks) with hover/focus previews, an imperative activateTurn/scrollToTurn handle, and a pointer guard so auto-follow never moves the rail under the cursor.
Turn-process control skin (33px row, hairline bottom border, tertiary label).
Completed-turn duration/status control; stopped and failed turns show no elapsed time, and the label distinguishes completed/failed/stopped.
Turn-tail layout: root column with 16px gap and a 4px actions offset.
Completed-turn footer: turnTail extension slot, assistant action slot, branch action (disabled when later content exists), and the per-turn usage panel.
Trigger notice skin: bordered card with a neutral background that changes on hover.
Independent expandable notice explaining a non-human turn trigger; opening it shows the recorded body and does not imply successful execution.
Usage pill skin; adjacent pills rebate internal padding so the pair reads as one cluster.
Per-turn token-usage pill and portaled details dialog; unavailable optional buckets are omitted rather than invented.
Local calendar-day tick hook; memoized message rows keep stable props across midnight, so the clock needs its own day seat.
Turn jumps and history paging: a loaded Turn scrolls, an unloaded Turn pages history through its seq first, and a reader gesture interrupts a landed jump.

Owns follow-tail ownership, sampled reader movement, and semantic scroll memory; a pinned scroll or a floor arrival within subpixel rounding updates follow immediately, other movement waits for the sample interval or scrollend.
Composes viewport, reading policy, and navigation; computes "own input" so a fold lands at the tail only when this client sent the message or the reader was following.
800-line viewport owner: turn-aware DOM reads, semantic anchors, the fold driver, and paging compensation that gives the inner group scroll first and the outer scrollport the remainder.
Independent disclosure state bound to a reset generation: a mode change keeps the version and so keeps the open state; only an enclosing Turn hiding bumps it.
Capped group scrolling with edge fades and its OWN follow controller, independent of the outer transcript; wheel/touch/pointer/unprevented-key interrupt the animation.
Bottom-follow intent plus native smooth scrolling, with an outstanding-target model so growth retargets instead of restarting, and reduced-motion downgrades to instant.
Subscribes to one value from a Turn's keyed Location-data store.
The session-scoped user content Factory: text, ordered attachments, extra blocks, and reference summary; the caller owns row identity, pending/echo state, time and actions.
hasAssistantReplyContent: a reply is text/image/other, never reasoning or a tool-call protocol block.
The Chat node contract: view-node shape with anchorSeq/location/visibility/groupTree, the merge-extensible payload map, exact turn-token-usage types, and the settled/running tool predicates.
Chat-only row filter: system prompts and ordinary context are hidden, but context carrying tool additions/removals stays visible, and permission commands are hidden.
The group-tree position vocabulary (exchange/input/turn/process) with a DEPTH map and isAtOrOutside, so one declaration places a node for grouping, folding and answer detection.
ProcessActivity category union, the ranked-count + live-detail summary type, and the ProcessGroupData payload merged into the conversation group map.
451-line declaration of every Chat Slot, Factory, Hook and injected face, including the group-tree-anchored ownership props and the quota-notice chain contract.
The ChatSnapshot contract: per-key observable node sources, the location index, the navigation index, the legacy compatibility slice, and EMPTY_CHAT_SNAPSHOT.
Per-Session Chat store state: one manual whole-Turn disclosure entry per Turn answer generation (collapsed flag, answerStep).
Derives per-step TTFT, decode wall time and output tokens, using null for every unrecorded part rather than zero.
Turn process spec plus sameTurnProcessSpec, the subagent-delegation name test, and the always-open rule for live/stopped/failed Turns.
Assistant step Definition: streams blocks, counts visible blocks, resets state on llm/retry while keeping firstTokenTime, and materializes an interrupted assistant from the closed boundary.

1244-line incremental Chat target builder: identity-stable keyed sources, dirty-key publication, turn/step location index, bottom-exchange membership, reference-label and skill-name projectors, and the legacy stats slice.
Slash-command Definition with manual-compaction correlation (the compact checkpoint's sourceCommandId links the two) and shared compaction evidence folding.
Synthetic seq offsets that place UI-only rows between durable events (process control, max-tokens notice, interrupted assistant) plus location helpers and the chatNode builder.
Automatic-compaction Definition: renders the landed checkpoint marker, and defers to the command Definition when the compaction was command-initiated.

Durable-event to Chat-view conversions: producer/form/label projection, assistant block classification, and displayFailure, which DROPS the message of an AUTH failure because a provider may echo a credential.
Unknown-surface fallback Definition: any append-surface event no other Definition claims still renders as a JSON row instead of vanishing.
Splits loaded Turns into consecutive exchange segments at Turns holding an opening Node, tracking per-Turn opening counts so only the Turns that entered or left the latest segment are notified.
Replays durable inbox splices as a pending chain and classifies a claimed human message as steering; a canceled splice claims nothing.
User/steering/context/developer message Definition; only human input claimed for Step 1 opens an exchange, every other input stays an input position.
Tool-name classification into 13 categories, distinct-call counting with callId dedupe, and live detail extraction with grapheme-safe truncation of a still-streaming argument.
Definition-owned process grouping: segmentation by group-tree position, incremental summaries per group, identity preserved across history prepends, and regrouping limited to the changed Turn.
Per-heading EN/ZH hash record for the conversation-nodes README.
331-line executable business-rule spec: whole-Turn folding, the four display modes, collapse timing, group segmentation, category counting and live-detail selection.
Chinese mirror of the conversation-nodes business rules.
Registration entry point: fourteen node Definitions plus the Chat view builder and the process-group definition.
System-prompt and request-prompt Definitions: initial cards precede their step's input while in-history prompt updates stay at their own positions.
Model-retry Definition: attempts share one producer RetryId, a scheduled attempt becomes cancelled once its step or turn closes, and the node sits at the process position.

Tool-call Definition: preparing/started/result lifecycle, streamed argument fragments retained only in the Tool node, nested PTC subcalls with cycle and depth guards, and a synthetic interrupted result.
Terminal turn failure Definition; error, sign-out and DSH-process-exit each get their own code, while completed/blocked/max-tokens/forked endings get NO failure row.
Max-tokens notice Definition, anchored between the closing assistant and the turn tail so the tail stays the turn's last node with its branch action enabled.
Derives a rail item per loaded Turn with bounded (50/120 char) previews, deliberately mirroring the host turnOutline projection.
Cross-node process layout facts per Turn (turnStarted/turnClosed/hasExternalProcess/hasInterleavedInput/compactAnswer), recomputed only for the Turns an update touched.
Turn-scoped process range and answer-boundary Definition; the answer is the latest step's settled reply with no tool-call block, and reasoning attached to it stays process content.
Completed-turn footer Definition; the closing assistant is the last finalized text reply, and branchUnavailable is true when later non-rendered evidence exists.
The public client entry: re-exports the contracts and opens ChatNodeDataMap for other plugins to contribute renderer payloads.
Chat locale namespace; the Simplified Chinese dictionary is the key-set source of truth and ChatKey is derived from it, with the English dictionary beside it.
Builds the complete Markdown chrome copy (code fence, footnotes) for one locale revision.
Type of one immutable model-context generation reconstructed from surface replacements (compaction/rewind/rewrite origin).
Reconstructs durable steering identity from agent/inbox/spliced events, so a user/message is steering only when it was claimed from next-step.
Owns PTC dispatch pairing and projects it into the recursive tool contract, refusing edges that would create a cycle or exceed the 256 depth limit.
Performance/usage preference: publishes the choice immediately and reconciles with accepted Host settings, staying usable when the Host write is refused.
Mode-to-capability policy TABLE (compact/standard/detailed/verbose); the same (mode,timing) pair always returns the same object, so the policy identity is stable for React.
Settings row for where Chat HTTP(S) links open; hidden entirely when the Sidebar Browser is not registered.
Settings row for the performance/usage detail level (compact/detailed).
Two-column preference row skin (label + description + a 36px selector pill); the only sheet in the package that lives under settings/ rather than chat/.
Localized preference selector whose menu restores focus to its trigger (without scrolling) BEFORE publishing the new value.
Two independent Settings rows: the work-details mode and the collapse timing.
Chat store definition and turnProcessOpen, where a stored choice for the CURRENT answer generation wins and older turns fall back to the default.
TranscriptViewPolicy: adopts accepted Host values for mode and timing, maps legacy modes to detailed WITHOUT writing back, and never writes a default.
Ambient declarations for *.module.css and *.css imports.
Host-side entry: projects the four Chat preferences to the browser as volatile config and registers the settings namespace.

Assembly test of the apply() inject surface: independent Settings choices, keyed Group sources, history paging and fork, session-scoped file addressing, link opening with and without a Sidebar Browser, and a loud failure when a view inject resolves no Session.
Pins commandOf (only a string command from valid JSON) and the ApprovalCommand renderer's correlation rules (preparing and settled calls are omitted).
Pins localPathMediaUrl: absolute POSIX paths map to the file route, unsupported transports and non-local destinations stay inert, URL escapes are decoded once.

Pins the plugin wiring: presentation helpers stay out of the public entry, the quota host is frame-wide, node dispatch lives in the shared flow, another registrant can replace one composer pill by id, and unloading removes only Chat contributions.

Large component test for user bubbles and context forms: session/skill chips, copy fallback and epoch-guarded feedback, every context form plus its all-or-nothing fallback, compaction marker expansion, and the clock's local-midnight refresh.
Static CSS assertions that every chat row scales with the content-font-size axis, including the 22px+delta body indent and the narrow-viewport stat-pill collapse.
Pins the bottom-exchange membership: only the Turns entering or leaving the latest exchange are notified, and a bare Turn boundary stays in the exchange until an opening Node arrives.
Pins the keyed node sources: ordered projected Nodes, previous values for grouping, and only the updated key notified among 4000 mounted sources.

Fold/scroll integration over the real viewport: 14 measured visible-fold cases, deferred collapse timing, coalescing several submissions into one fold, and no obsolete viewport writes when every closing row reopens.

574-line ChatSnapshot fixture: builds the nodes, location index, navigation index, process presentation and legacy slice from one input, deriving the derived parts with the PRODUCTION functions rather than hard-coding them, and keeping per-key sources identity-stable.

Pins the stats fold and the two composer pills: deriveStats sums LLM/tool wall time and TTFT, dialogs carry the exact buckets, at most one dialog is open, and the durable projection wins over the paged window.
Pins the Chat store: a manual expansion applies to the current answer generation, closing one Turn leaves the others, and the default is used only without a matching stored choice.

4407-line end-to-end component test of the Chat view: all four work-details modes, Turn rail and paging, local echo to durable node handoff, quota/failure rows, process folding, and the file-mention vocabulary.

Pins the viewport: paging marker selection without measuring other rows, hidden/empty marker skipping, group-body compensation before the outer scrollport, and the reading-gesture release of the paging anchor.
Host settings registration: namespace validation, independent collapse timing, loading without a settings provider, and keeping the instance off the generated Settings pages.

2882-line test of every node Definition across replay/live/prepend: inbox classification, exchange opening, process window projection, answer boundary, tool preparation/settlement, compaction markers and turn tail.
Pins the event-projection helpers: the four block shapes, empty streamed blocks, AUTH redaction, and non-empty token deltas.
Two targeted AssistantMarkdown assertions: reasoning renders as a Think row with unknown blocks as JSON fallback, and the root shell is skipped when only tool-call heads remain.
Pins producer/form/label projection: plugin producers, invoked skills, instruction files, session recall, unknown producers identified by their durable kind, and the opaque degradation.
Pins motion scoping: fold anchoring and batch room stay isolated between viewports, and ordinary searchable hiding stays immediate inside a motion-enabled parent.
635-line test of the fold coordinator: batch ordering, travelling boxes staying opaque, held rows, reduced motion, cancellation semantics, style cleanup, and StrictMode replay.

Pins the fold landing rule: a following reader lands at the tail, a non-following reader's content stays still, subpixel floor rounding restores follow immediately, and one pixel of movement stays pending.
Three gate assertions: the reasoning row is ok-state when not the streaming tail, the stats fall back to window-node counts without projections, and the streaming tail renders the running ring.
Pins the exchange segmentation: the position depth order, only the Turns that moved are reported, opening counts fall back as openings leave, and the segment clears with no loaded Turn.
Pins the assistant image slot: one group per consecutive image run, the loader change does not remount the sibling gallery, and the renderer output stays at the image block position.

Pins the performance preference: an explicit choice stays live while the Host write is pending or refused, accepted settings are adopted at construction and after updates, and the subscription is released on unload.
10-line fixture exposing a fixed Detailed presentation policy for isolated Assistant Markdown component tests.
Pins the policy table: all eight mode/timing policies are distinct and stable, both subscriptions are removed on disposal, and only consumers whose selected field changed re-render.

549-line test of grouping and activity: grapheme-safe truncation across deltas, a surrogate pair split across two deltas, group identity across prepends, splitting/joining on a separator, and rescoping only the changed Turn.

Pins the frame-wide quota notice: one notice per live append, never for history replacement or paging, the notice outlives the viewed Session, a hold survives until released, and a stale release cannot clear a newer hold.
Child-renderer stubs that render the production ReasoningContent without emulating the slot registry; rejects any unexpected Slot or Factory key.

Pins the root-scoped reasoning Content Factory: renders without a Session Provider, uses complete caller labels unchanged, keeps wrapping state independent per occurrence, and restores the default after a plugin unloads.
Real Slot/Factory runtime fixture (SlotTestRuntime + LocaleRuntime + the shipped renderer registration) for the standalone reasoning component tests.

448-line test of reasoning rows: blank blocks omitted, expanded state retained across modes, running preview in Compact, streaming preview advancing on completed paragraph first lines, and the sticky-header selector anchors.
Pins the running clock: it waits for an open Turn start, stays mounted across a run moving to the next Turn, and never renders a negative duration.
Pins the whale: a decorative mask seat plus static SVG with no inline styles, and asserts a 28px alpha APNG with sixty 50ms frames playing infinitely.

Pins the follow controller: fractional floors do not await native events, growth retargets instead of restarting, a native stop off target releases following, and reduced motion forces immediate positioning.
Pins skill-name attachment: names attach to every direct message of a boundary-free batch, an assistant-only apply neither scans the store nor re-emits messages, and a boundary splits the batch.

Static CSS assertions for the pinned collapsible headers: the open Think header pins to the scrollport top, the compaction header outranks the code banner, and the pinned header stays opaque under hover.
Pins the system-prompt row: the opaque body mounts only while expanded, and an in-history update is titled as an update of the same row.
Pins the PTC tree guards: a self-parenting edge is rejected, a cycle-closing edge is rejected, an acyclic graph with a shared descendant is accepted, and the depth limit rejects an over-deep edge.

Pins tool preparation: assistant state is unchanged for parameter-only deltas while the Tool reader advances, late deltas after block-end are ignored, repeated named deltas retain the node, and stored assistant streams never create preparing rows.
Pins the tool-change presentation: counts collapsed, compact comma-separated name lists when expanded.
Pins the work-details policy: legacy normal/expanded read as detailed without a write-back, an explicit choice is preserved without a migration write, and no browser storage is touched.
Pins the Settings rows: mode and timing change independently, focus returns to the trigger BEFORE publishing, and all four work-detail values appear in Chinese.
Pins the per-step reading (TTFT needs both boundaries, negatives clamp to zero, a non-finite usage count is rejected) and the footer formatters.
Installs a ResizeObserver and element-local scrolling absent from jsdom so the rail can be measured and scrolled in tests.

Pins the rail: the active turn is placed on the first viewport size without a scroll command, activation and scrolling are separate controls, keyboard focus stays mounted across virtual ranges, and a scroll-induced pointer entry does not replace a focused preview.
Pins partial windows: Step Locations and first-token timing survive message settlement, replay and prepend, and a missing-start footer is retained after a stream retirement.
Pins the rail merge: outline-only turns become unloaded marks, the loaded side wins on overlap but empty previews are filled from the outline, and damaged navigation fields drop an entry.
One assertion that the flow offset and the footer offset combine around turn-tail content.
Pins the trigger notice: every source family gets its own title/icon, the recorded body opens independently of the Turn, and malformed sources degrade to the generic title.
Pins the per-turn usage pill and dialog: unavailable optional facts are omitted, a partial cache hit stays below 100, and the dialog closes on Escape or an outside pointerdown/click.

Pins injected disclosure state: local reveal/collapse without a reset source, subscription only where the forwarded Hook is called, and each disclosure independent while one source resets all its consumers.
Binds real user-text parsing and the production UserContent component for component-level tests, rejecting any unexpected Factory name.

Pins the user content Factory: prepared text renders without row chrome, attachments keep their prepared order through the image Slot, reference and skill actions open only in interactive content, and a Session binding is required.
Type-level assertion that Chat injection and store props stay out of the target-neutral Conversation view base.
Client project: 36 workspace project references with src included and the host entry excluded; emits lib/types with its own tsbuildinfo, so the browser build cannot reuse the Host build's state.

Host project: a files WHITELIST of only src/chat-settings.ts and src/index.ts, extending the base (non-client) config and referencing the settings package; the split is expressed from both sides so neither half leaks into the other.
Solution-style file with files: [] and references to the host and client projects.
